channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-data-engineering
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: adbcBridge — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Driver for ADBC, Apache Arrow's database connectivity API, that sits on top of any ODBC driver, so databases with no native Arrow driver return columnar Arrow record batches and take bulk ingest.

item.title: mq-bridge — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Embeddable Rust engine and CLI that moves data between Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, MQTT, SQL databases, Postgres/MongoDB CDC and Parquet on S3/GCS/Azure, with bindings for Python and Node.js.

item.title: dataprof — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Data profiling and quality gates for CSV, JSON, Parquet, DataFrames and Arrow tables, with a Rust core and a Python API.

item.title: Titan — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: A scalable graph database optimized for storing and querying graphs containing hundreds of billions of vertices and edges distributed across a multi-machine cluster.

item.title: Timeplus Proton — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Streaming SQL engine in a single C++ binary, powered by ClickHouse; a lightweight alternative to Flink and ksqlDB for streaming ETL, windowed aggregations, joins and materialized views over Kafka.

item.title: Streamlit — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: An open-source Python framework for building interactive data apps and dashboards with minimal code. Connects to any data source and supports real-time updates, caching, and one-click deployment.

item.title: Spring Cloud Dataflow — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Streaming and tasks execution between Spring Boot apps.

item.title: SmoothieCharts — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: A JavaScript Charting Library for Streaming Data.

item.title: SequenceFile — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: A flat file consisting of binary key/value pairs. It is extensively used in MapReduce as input/output formats.

item.title: Riak — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: A distributed database designed to deliver maximum data availability by distributing data across multiple servers.

item.title: Renart — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Local-first IDE for authoring and running SQL and Python data pipelines stored in Git.

item.title: Pixeltable — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Declarative multimodal AI data engine providing versioned tables, computed columns, incremental transformation, and vector search.

item.title: OrientDB — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: 2nd Generation Distributed Graph Database with the flexibility of Documents in one product with an Open Source commercial friendly license.

item.title: OpenChainBench — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Live dataset of crypto infrastructure benchmarks (RPC latency, oracle deviation, bridge fees, L1 finality, perp DEX metrics). Open methodology, CC BY 4.0, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20800312. Source.

item.title: OLake — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Open-source replication of Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Kafka and S3 into Apache Iceberg, with CDC and table maintenance. Written in Go.

item.title: GeoSQL — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Claude/Codex skill for cost-safe geospatial SQL on BigQuery and Snowflake.

item.title: Firecrawl — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Open-source web data API that scrapes, crawls, maps, and searches the web and returns Markdown or structured JSON for data pipelines and LLM ingestion.

item.title: Dex — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Agent-native warehouse profiling, join verification, and schema-drift detection with dbt transformation workflows.

item.title: Dataform — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: An open-source framework and web based IDE to manage datasets and their dependencies. SQLX extends your existing SQL warehouse dialect to add features that support dependency management, testing, documentation and more.

item.title: DataOps TestGen — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Open-source data quality tool that profiles tables, generates validation tests from the profiling results, and monitors freshness, volume, and schema from a web UI.

item.title: Data Council — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: The first technical conference that bridges the gap between data scientists, data engineers and data analysts.

item.title: Data Contract CLI — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Tests data in Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Kafka and other sources against data contracts in the Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS), and converts contracts to and from SQL DDL, dbt, Avro and JSON Schema.

item.title: Ciaren — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: A local-first visual ETL and ML workflow builder with per-step previews, cron scheduling, and export to pandas or Polars code.

item.title: Cascading — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Java based application development platform.

item.title: CardinalityEstimation — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: C# library using HyperLogLog for approximate distinct counting in data streams, with mergeable estimators and serialization.

item.title: dbmask — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Open-source tool that scans SQL databases for sensitive columns, masks them with deterministic fakes, and validates the masked copy row by row against the original.

item.title: Scriptella ETL — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Open-source, Java-based ETL and script execution tool for transferring and transforming data between databases, files, and other sources.

item.title: ReductStore — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: High-performance blob and time-series storage, with edge deployment, selective replication, and efficient querying of multimodal data.

item.title: Manticore Search — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: An open-source search database for full-text, vector, and hybrid search with real-time indexing and SQL.

item.title: Jitsu — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: An open-source Customer Data Platform. Captures event data from websites, apps, and servers and streams it into ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Postgres, and MySQL in real time.

item.title: FlexViz — via awesome-data-engineering
item.description: Open-source Python library for interactive cross-filter dashboards on large datasets. Zoom, pan, and selection are answered by lazy Polars aggregations on a stateless server instead of sending rows to the browser.
